scope: Static review of pinned source, not profiler findings or measured optimizations

candidates.target: Prefill Hadamard plus Q8 activation preparation
candidates.evidence: ggml_cuda_try_fwht_q8 permits only consumers routed to MMVQ. Large prefill consumers route to MMQ. MMQ prepares quantized activations per invocation. Existing shared-MMQ Q8 reuse is gated to DGX Spark (1210) and Q1/Q2/PQ2 types; our GPU is SM120 (1200) and PTQ is excluded.
candidates.proposal: Add an MMQ-compatible fused transform/quantization or share immutable prepared activations between compatible consumers.
candidates.constraints: Keep Hadamard butterfly order, quantizer rounding/scales/layout, strides/padding, alias checks and CUDA-graph lifetime unchanged; prove applicability and redundancy with a trace.

candidates.evidence: Branch-free trit loader already fetches word 6 containing qh and scale; a separate loop reloads the same FP16 block scale for multiple entries.
candidates.proposal: Evaluate populating scale tile entries using the already loaded scale bits.
candidates.constraints: Preserve exact FP16-to-F32 conversion and the final shared-memory tile layout; avoid new divergence, race or occupancy loss.

candidates.evidence: has_gate invokes ptq1_0_pt_block_dot twice on the same ycol: primary weights and gate weights.
candidates.proposal: Process both row sets in one dot helper, reusing activation int4 loads.
candidates.constraints: Keep per-output integer dots, fold order, FMA operations and invariant warp epilogue; register pressure may erase the benefit.

candidates.evidence: ggml_cuda_try_fwht_q8 scans every later node and source slot for each candidate; evaluation loop calls it while CUDA graph work is being prepared.
candidates.proposal: Precompute validated consumer/alias relationships per stable graph generation.
candidates.constraints: Invalidate on topology, shapes, addresses, alias changes and dispatch/layout changes. CUDA graph replay already skips this path; likely smaller decode benefit.

candidates.target: Unnecessary host consumer-map construction on SM120
candidates.evidence: ggml_cuda_graph_evaluate_and_capture builds gb10_shared_q8_consumer_counts for every graph call before its capture/replay conditional. All consuming paths are gated to DGX Spark 1210; our SM120 has cc 1200.
candidates.proposal: Gate construction to the architecture/features that consume the map, or hoist an immutable map into validated graph-generation state.
candidates.constraints: Architecture gating can leave the SM120 device work unchanged. Graph-caching requires invalidation. Benefit is host overhead, not established GPU prefill speed.

already_present: Wide PTQ MMQ tiles and branch-free unpacking from PR214
Hadamard+Q8 fusion for eligible MMVQ consumers
Exact activation sums and integer bias correction
Invariant warp epilogue and CUDA graph reuse
Shared MMQ Q8 reuse for DGX Spark and Q1/Q2/PQ2, currently excluding PTQ and SM120
not_quality_preserving_shortcuts: Disabling GGML_CUDA_BATCH_INVARIANT as a presumed free speedup
Reducing KV precision or dropping Hadamard/state operations
validation: Before any performance claim: trace current 30k prefill, establish operation share, implement one isolated change, compare exact outputs of affected kernels and representative end-to-end logits; then identified interleaved timing plus API/vision/coding QA.
